name: affaan-m/ECC
title: affaan-m/ECC
headline: ECC bundles skills and memory for coding agents
lede: Teams can drop one package of skills, memory and security rules into several coding agent harnesses.

effects.effect: Harness configs start to be shared across vendors
Packages harness setup so it can be reused across tools.

appearances.title: affaan-m/ECC
appearances.summary: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
